summary: Key the fractal-web CI shell closure by its exact Nix derivation identity rather than all flake source files, preserving cache hits for unrelated Rust changes. Log runner CPU, cores, name and available region once per web job.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The versioned web-shell cache uses exact derivation keys without prefix restoration. Restored entries must record the expected identity; mismatched or incomplete entries fall back to nix develop. Real transitive web toolchain changes invalidate the cache.

manual.detail: No manual step; only protected-main upkeep populates the new cache format. Pull requests and merge groups remain restore-only.

recovery.detail: A cache miss evaluates the current web shell normally.
